question: How many orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T'

question: total order quantity
sql: SELECT SUM(OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T'

question: average order quantity
sql: SELECT AVG(OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T'

question: Buyer wise order quantity
sql: SELECT b.BUYERNAME, SUM(o.OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} o LEFT JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY b.BUYERNAME

question: size wise quantity
sql: SELECT z.SIZES, SUM(s.RQTY) FROM {ORDSIZE} s JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = s.ORDMASID LEFT JOIN {SIZE_MAS} z ON z.SIZE_MASID = s.GSIZE WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY z.SIZES

question: colour wise number of orders
sql: SELECT c.COLOR, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDMASID) FROM {ORDSTYLE} l JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = l.ORDMASID LEFT JOIN {COLORMAS} c ON c.COLORMASID = l.COMBO WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY c.COLOR

question: monthly order quantity
sql: SELECT {MONTH(ODATE)}, SUM(OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY {MONTH(ODATE)}

question: How many orders for {p_buyer}?

params.p_buyer: SELECT b.BUYERNAME FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY b.BUYERNAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.BUYERNAME

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE b.BUYERNAME = :p_buyer AND (o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T')

question: colour wise quantity for {p_buyer}

params.p_buyer: SELECT b.BUYERNAME FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY b.BUYERNAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.BUYERNAME

sql: SELECT c.COLOR, SUM(l.ORDQTY) FROM {ORDSTYLE} l JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = l.ORDMASID JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER LEFT JOIN {COLORMAS} c ON c.COLORMASID = l.COMBO WHERE b.BUYERNAME = :p_buyer AND (o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T') GROUP BY c.COLOR

question: size wise quantity for order {p_order}

params.p_order: SELECT o.DOCID FROM {ORDMAS} o WHERE (o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T') AND o.DOCID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {ORDSIZE} s WHERE s.ORDMASID = o.ORDMASID) ORDER BY o.ORDMASID DESC

sql: SELECT z.SIZES, SUM(s.RQTY) FROM {ORDSIZE} s JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = s.ORDMASID LEFT JOIN {SIZE_MAS} z ON z.SIZE_MASID = s.GSIZE WHERE o.DOCID = :p_order GROUP BY z.SIZES

question: which buyer has order {p_order}

params.p_order: SELECT DOCID FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE (CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T') AND DOCID IS NOT NULL AND BUYER IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ORDMASID DESC

sql: SELECT b.BUYERNAME FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.DOCID = :p_order
